items.criterion: A read run returns rows, a row count, a duration and a declared type per column.
items.judgment: Read the run answer and confirm the four fields are present and typed.

items.criterion: An app carrying components at non-default positions reopens with every position, size and binding intact.
items.judgment: Save operations, re-read the app and compare the component rectangle and the binding expression.

items.criterion: A read-only group's mutating call is refused at the server and the target row is unchanged.
items.judgment: Call the mutating query with a read-only session and re-read the row.

items.criterion: An explicit deny at the workspace scope survives a narrower allow on the same action.
items.judgment: Add a narrow allow beneath the seeded deny and read the decision answer.

items.criterion: An action no grant reaches answers deny at every scope.
items.judgment: Ask the decision endpoint for each action a principal holds no grant for.

items.criterion: Two members in different groups receive different row sets from one query.
items.judgment: Run the same query as each member and compare the row counts and the statuses.

items.criterion: A masked column never leaves the server for a restricted member.
items.judgment: Compare the stored column value against the value served to the restricted member.

items.criterion: A promotion to the protected environment with no approval is refused.
items.judgment: Freeze a version and promote it without an approval.

items.criterion: The requester of an approval cannot grant that approval.
items.judgment: Request an approval and decide it from the same session.

items.criterion: Two contending promotions on one approval produce exactly one release.
items.judgment: Fire two promotions at once and count the release rows before and after.

items.criterion: The audit chain verifies and reports the first divergent sequence number.
items.judgment: Call the verification endpoint on a freshly seeded workspace.

items.criterion: A repeated idempotency key leaves exactly one changed row.
items.judgment: Run the mutating query twice under one key and count the matching rows.

items.criterion: A single grid page never carries the whole seeded table.
items.judgment: Request a page and compare its length against the seeded row count.

items.criterion: An invitation reaches the invited address alone with the workspace name in its subject.
items.judgment: Invite an address and read the mail sink for that recipient.

items.criterion: An invitation token is accepted once and refused on a second acceptance.
items.judgment: Accept a token twice and compare the two answers.

items.criterion: An unknown address and a wrong password are refused indistinguishably.
items.judgment: Sign in with each and compare the status and the body.

items.criterion: A stale resource credential answers unreachable and carries no credential fragment.
items.judgment: Probe the stale resource and scan the answer for host, user and secret text.

items.criterion: Every console endpoint refuses a caller with no session.
items.judgment: Call each console endpoint without a bearer token.
